event_resampling_w1_sample_sum_ratio_gai.interpretation: Event-resampling interval for variation within this public 2020 sample; not a confidence interval for candidate-pixel truth.

interpretation_limits: Candidate weights are sensitivity scenarios, not calibrated probabilities.
Sample-sum ratios aggregate instantaneous FRP values descriptively and are not FRE or emissions.
Detection spans describe recorded detections, not continuous physical burning duration.
No independent truth labels are used, so this analysis does not estimate precision or recall.
